claims.text: A subdomain is one part of the problem the business solves; a bounded context is a boundary in the software; the two often match but need not: two subdomains can share one context, and one subdomain can be split across two.
claims.source_hint: Domain-Driven Design (Evans), Distillation / strategic design: subdomains vs bounded contexts

claims.text: The core domain is the part that sets the business apart and earns the most design care; which part is core is a business decision, not a technical one; being critical (e.g. signing in) does not make a part core.
claims.source_hint: Domain-Driven Design (Evans), Distillation: Core Domain; outline items 2 and misconception 3

claims.text: A supporting subdomain is specific to the business but simple; a generic subdomain is a problem most businesses share, such as signing in or sending email, usually solved by reusing existing work.
claims.source_hint: Domain-Driven Design (Evans), Distillation: Generic Subdomains; outline item 3

claims.text: At stage-2 DonHang.Api/Program.cs is 126 lines long, mostly setup for services, authentication, metrics and health checks, with no ordering rule; the ordering rules sit in Order's constructor (at least one item, quantity >= 1) and its three methods.
With no recorded business decision on what is core, the lesson reads the code's effort as a stand-in: Đơn Hàng's code treats ordering as core; whether that is right is the business's call.

When the team must choose, effort on a generic subdomain buys the result other businesses get, and effort on a rule-free supporting subdomain buys code with nothing to protect; the core is where better design pays back.

When a part has no rules in its class, domain-model methods guard nothing; a direct query or transaction script suits it. The product list is still not generic: no tool others built holds Đơn Hàng's own products and prices, so the team writes it, kept simple.
When a tool built for a generic problem (e.g. Keycloak for sign-in) already covers it, building it in-house spends design effort where it buys no difference.
